jobs.occupation: Experienced High Voltage Specialist wanted for Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst
jobs.description:
Do you have at least three years of high voltage experience? At Bravida, you will install circuit breakers, disconnectors and switchboards and help build substations. Here, you will put your experience to use on critical electrical infrastructure projects that help secure Denmark’s power supply and support the green transition.

On behalf of Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst, Career | a JKS Company is recruiting experienced High Voltage Specialists for projects across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst has secured the framework agreement with Energinet, becoming a regular supplier of high voltage installation work across Zealand and Lolland-Falster. With this agreement and a strong order book, Bravida is expanding the department. You will join the team responsible for building, expanding, refurbishing and maintaining the infrastructure that the power grid of the future relies on.

Installation and construction of high voltage installations
You will work at substations and other high voltage installations, putting your experience into practice. You will take responsibility for your own tasks and work alongside your team to deliver safe, high-quality work.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Installing and replacing circuit breakers, disconnectors and other substation components

• 
Carrying out cable work and working on earthing systems

• 
Working on switchboards, electrical installations and dismantling tasks

• 
Contributing to the construction, refurbishment and maintenance of high voltage installations

• 
Carrying out quality assurance and maintaining documentation

Over time, you will also share your knowledge by helping apprentices and new colleagues get to grips with their tasks.

You bring solid high voltage experience and take responsibility
You are a qualified electrician or have an equivalent electrical qualification, with at least three years of hands-on experience in high voltage work. You are familiar with the tasks described and comfortable working independently. You take initiative, recognise what needs doing and understand that safety is integral to every task.

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Works independently and takes a structured approach

• 
Takes responsibility for the safety and quality of their work

• 
Is proactive, well-presented and works well with others

• 
Is physically fit and comfortable with hands-on work outdoors and at height

• 
Holds a category B driving licence and can provide a criminal record certificate

You must be able to communicate clearly in English and have a valid work permit for Denmark.

A company vehicle to take home and no on-call duties
At Bravida, you will join a team of skilled, dedicated technicians who take pride in their work.

You will work daytime hours with no on-call duties, normally five days a week. Start times depend on the project, and the working week can be discussed. The role is paid hourly, with pay based on qualifications, plus pension contributions and a flexible benefits allowance under the Danish “fritvalgsordning” scheme.

You will have a company vehicle equipped with the tools and equipment you need, which you can take home. Your exact location is therefore less important, provided you are willing to work at different sites across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

We look forward to hearing from you
If this sounds like the right role for you, please send us your CV. We review applications and invite suitable candidates to interviews on an ongoing basis, and will close the vacancy once the right candidates have been found.

If you have any questions about the role that are not covered in this advertisement, please contact Recruitment Specialist Kristine Askjær on +45 3085 1302.

Please note that, for GDPR reasons, applications submitted directly by email will not be processed or receive a response.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager of Construction Management at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead impactful construction projects that shape the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing - while fostering a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment? Then we hope to hear from you.

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

As the Senior Manager of Construction Management, you will contribute to keep strengthening our competencies, deliver high-quality results and to the strategy for the Construction Management function. You will also collaborate across departments to ensure alignment with broader business objectives.

Your leadership style should be passionate about creating a culture where people thrive, and you understand that high performance is built on trust, engagement, and a shared purpose – building on the foundation of NNE leadership principles. This is a unique opportunity to lead our organisation into effective operations, high compliance standards and a strong business focus.

How you might spend your days

As Senior Manager of Construction Management, you’ll:

• Lead and develop a high-performing construction management, while developing team capabilities and well-being

• Ensure successful project execution through effective site mobilisation and risk management

• Establish and continuously improve systems for construction management, including planning, resourcing, and budgeting.

• Build and manage effective client relationships on site, ensuring stakeholder alignment and project success.

• Ensure compliance with project plans, NNE’s quality standards, and execution model.

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you:

• Translate high-level goals into actionable plans and guide your team through ambiguity with clarity and confidence.

• Ability to mentor and coach team members across experience levels.

• Understand industry challenges, make informed decisions and take ownership of results.

• Embrace innovation and continuous learning, especially in digital tools.

• Contribute with a thoughtful and purpose-driven work style, and model the values and standards expected across the organization.

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Degree in engineering or a related technical field (M.Sc. or B.Sc.)

• Experience in construction and site management (typically 8-10 years)

• Experience establishing and developing systems within this field (including construction and commissioning planning, systems for managing temporary work and installations, etc.)

• Familiarity with 4D/5D tools and digital construction management.

• Commitment to safety and experience in safety-critical environments.

• Proficiency in English.

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 31st October 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Director of Project Management Jens Roy Krejberg Simonsen at +45 30796136.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

Are you a strong writer with an eye for design and a practical approach to using artificial intelligence?

Can you keep a website fresh, turn ideas into engaging social content, and build workflows that make content production more efficient?

Patiro is looking for a part-time Content and Creative Specialist to manage and develop our content across our website, social media, press releases, and external profiles. You will help us communicate clearly, maintain a consistent brand, and reach the right audiences.

Your responsibilities

You will help us:

• Plan and maintain a content calendar across our channels.

• Write, edit, publish, and update website content, social media posts, press releases, and other communications.

• Keep company listings, directories, and relevant registers accurate and up to date.

• Create visuals and reusable templates in Figma or similar design tools.

• Refine our brand guidelines and apply them consistently across content and design.

• Follow and develop our voice and tone guidelines, adapting communication to different audiences.

• Use artificial intelligence and automation tools, such as Make.com, to improve content workflows, approvals, publishing, and distribution.

• Repurpose content into formats suited to different channels and audiences.

• Improve content discoverability across search engines and artificial intelligence search and answer platforms.

• Track content performance and use the findings to improve topics, formats, and distribution.

• Coordinate with internal experts to ensure content is accurate, relevant, and ready for publication.

What we are looking for

You are someone who:

• Has experience creating and managing content across websites and social media.

• Writes clear, engaging English and can turn complex subjects into accessible stories.

• Has a strong visual eye and practical experience with Figma or similar tools.

• Can share examples of content and creative work you have produced.

• Has hands-on experience using artificial intelligence and automation tools to improve workflows while maintaining editorial quality.

• Understands how content can support awareness, engagement, and action.

• Keeps up with developments in search engine optimisation and content visibility across large language models, generative search, and answer engines.

• Works independently, manages priorities, and takes content from initial idea through publication and review.

• Checks facts carefully and handles sensitive topics with sound judgement.

Technical search optimisation skills are welcome, but are not required. We value strong editorial judgement, creative ability, and the ability to put useful tools into practice.

Additional experience we would value

• Healthcare, clinical research, or patient-facing communications.

• Press releases, media outreach, or corporate communications.

• Content management systems and publishing tools.

• Short-form video creation and editing.

• Community management and audience engagement.

• Content analytics and testing different messages or creative formats.

About the role

You will work closely with our leadership, marketing, and medical teams to build a consistent and credible presence for Patiro. We are looking for someone who can contribute ideas and take ownership of the daily work needed to keep our content relevant and our channels active.

Hours: 5-15 hours per weekStart date: As soon as possible

How to apply

Send your application, a short introduction, and examples of your writing and visual work to the email below.

Please also share an example of how you have used artificial intelligence or automation to improve a content workflow, including your role and the result.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Apply via this e-mail

careers@patiro.com

Have any questions?

Reach out to us if you have any questions related to the open positions.

You'll work directly with clients on projects where you can combine your technical expertise with consulting, business process improvement, and stakeholder management. Depending on the project, you may take on responsibilities as a specialist, business analyst, or project manager.

You'll become part of a collaborative, high-achieving consulting environment where professional development, knowledge sharing, and personal growth are highly valued.

Join our Enterprise Cost Steering team to lead initiatives that improve financial health through strategic cost optimization. This position offers a unique opportunity to influence cost efficiency strategies Group-wide.

_**What You Will Be Doing

**As an Experienced Consultant in Enterprise Cost Steering, you will support the executive leadership team with insights and recommendations to optimize cost structures. Working closely with Finance teams, Procurement, Support functions, and Business Units, you will identify cost-optimizing opportunities and implement best practices that strengthen our financial foundation.

• Own, drive, coordinate and execute end-to-end cost efficiency initiatives across the Group, including planning, tracking progress and managing delivery against agreed milestones

• Apply strong critical thinking by questioning assumptions and provide well-reasoned recommendations

• Leverage data analytics to conduct comprehensive cost analysis and identify cost efficiency opportunities

• Collaborate with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to design and implement cost steering frameworks, ensuring clear governance, roles and responsibilities

• Translate complex data into actionable insights for senior leadership

• Act as trusted partner providing expert guidance on strategic cost initiatives

• Build and maintain dashboards and tools to support ongoing cost analysis, generating actionable insights, reporting and decision-making

• Facilitate workshops to align stakeholders and build consensus on initiatives and drive agreed actions to completion

**About You

**

• Strong consulting and project management background, with experience delivering strategic solutions in complex organisations

• Solid experience in enterprise-level cost steering or strategic cost management

• Excellent problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail

• Proven ability to independently manage initiatives from ideation through execution, including defining scope, plans, milestones, dependencies and delivery risks

• Strong critical thinking skills with ability to challenge assumptions

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to engage, influence and build trust across all levels while maintaining alignment, accountability and momentum

• Advanced skills in data analysis, reporting and visualisation tools

• Master's degree in finance, economics, business administration or similar

You thrive in dynamic environments with evolving priorities and demonstrate collaborative teamwork alongside quantitative expertise to support strategic decision-making.

**What We Offer You

**You will join a supportive team that values collaboration and professional growth. We offer hybrid working with 3 to 4 days per week in the office to promote knowledge sharing and culture building. You will have opportunities to develop your expertise while making meaningful contributions to our financial health and cost efficiency initiatives.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**We would love to hear from you if this opportunity excites you. Please reach out to Hadis Atighi at kho@danskebank.dk for any questions about the role. We process applications continuously, so we encourage you to apply sooner rather than later.

We look forward to receiving your application!

All Gravy is the AI-native people operating platform for hospitality and retail. 🥞

We're modernising how frontline teams work, replacing scattered tools and outdated systems with a single app that's actually built for the way people work & socialise today. Our AI Colleague gives staff instant answers & executes day-to-day tasks, freeing up managers to focus on people & customers instead of paperwork. We work with some of the most exciting brands in hospitality and retail, including Gail's, L'Osteria, Dishoom, Pizza Pilgrims, Ottolenghi, Q8 and 7-Eleven. Today over 2,000 restaurants and stores trust us to run their teams.

We've grown 10x in two years and are accelerating into new markets. Our team spans a wide range of nationalities and backgrounds, united by one mission: to create better work lives for the 80% of the world that do not sit behind a desk. 🚀

🤩 **About the role

**We are looking for an AI Engineer to build the AI layer of All Gravy: agents that plan shifts, answer manager questions, and take real actions across 2,000+ hospitality and retail locations in the Nordics and UK.

This is a build role, not a research role. You will ship agents that customers use in production, then own how well they work. We are looking for someone who has already built and shipped AI agents and who is relentlessly curious about what just became possible. The field moves faster than any roadmap, so part of the job is noticing the new capability before anyone asks you to, testing it, and telling us whether it changes what we should build.

🎯 **What you will do

**

• Build agent harnesses. Design and ship agents that call internal and external tools to solve real customer problems, both interactively with users and autonomously in the background.

• Own the eval loop. Build the harnesses, datasets, and offline and online evals that tell us whether an agent got better or worse. You define what "working" means and you defend the number.

• Ship full stack. Take features end to end, from the manager and employee interfaces where schedules are built and shifts are picked up, through the backend services and data layers that power them.

• Run it in production. Own latency, cost, failure modes, and guardrails for the agents you ship. When one misbehaves at 6am on a Saturday, you are the person who understands why.

• Investigate what is new. Try the new models, frameworks, and techniques as they land, build small things to find out where they actually hold up, and bring back a clear read on what we should adopt and what we should ignore.

• Work across teams. Partner with product and the other engineering teams so AI features fit the wider All Gravy ecosystem, and contribute to shared standards and architectural decisions.

✅ **What we are looking for

**

• You have built agents that shipped to real users, not just demos. You can talk through what broke, what you changed, and what you would do differently.

• Genuine curiosity, evidenced by things you built. You have side projects, throwaway experiments, or strong opinions formed by actually running the thing rather than reading about it.

• Strong context and prompt engineering, including retrieval, tool design, and structured outputs. You know why an agent fails and it is usually not the model.

• Solid production engineering in TypeScript and Node.js, or the ability to get there fast from another typed language.

• Comfort reading and writing code, reviewing architecture, and working directly with infrastructure. You ship the fix rather than filing the ticket.

• Judgment about when an agent is the right answer and when a well placed SQL query or a boring deterministic rule is better.

🙌 **You'll thrive here if you

**We're looking for people with great energy, a good sense of humour, and a drive for getting things over the line. You think elegantly but act pragmatically, love being part of a team, and never stop learning

• 5+ years of proven full-stack experience across React, React Native, TypeScript, and Node.js.

• Ability to design and architect highly available, fault-tolerant, and scalable distributed systems.

• Startup or scale-up background. You know what it means to move fast, make pragmatic calls, and revisit them when the time is right.

• Fluent English, spoken and written.

• Based within European time zones, whether from our Copenhagen or London office or remotely.

An advantage if you have experience in:

• Vercel AI SDK

• Mastra or similar Agent framework

💎 **Why All Gravy

**

• Grow fast, for real. We promote from within, move quickly, and give you real responsibility from day one.

• Top equipment. You'll receive all new equipment to do your best work

• A culture that actually develops you. Honest feedback, active coaching, and the autonomy to experiment. We invest in you because your growth is our growth.

• Work that matters. Your work will directly impact the daily lives of millions of frontline workers.

• You'll work with people who've built, scaled, and won. Ex-founders, operators, all here because they want to do it again, bigger.

• The good stuff too. Prime office location, team lunches, Friday bars, padel tournaments, wine tastings, offsites, top-tier equipment, and a fridge that's always stocked. We work hard and celebrate harder.

💡 Even if you do not tick every box on this page, you might be the perfect fit for the job! We treasure our learning culture and encourage all humble people to apply.

**Shape the Future of Privacy

**

Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.

**About the Office of AI

**

The Office of AI owns the strategy, governance, infrastructure, and enablement of AI across Usercentrics. We sit within the CTO office and work across all departments.

Mission: enable the entire organisation to adopt AI safely, responsibly, and effectively.

**About the role

**

You are the hands-on technical arm of AI adoption at Usercentrics. Finance, Legal, HR, Marketing, Customer Success, BI and every other department have real AI use cases, and your job is to turn them into governed, working software, not slide decks.

You will prototype and build department AI applications, run technical enablement sessions directly with the teams who will use them, and make sure everything you ship meets our governance standards before it goes live. You work from the use-case pipeline the AI Enablement Lead runs, and you report progress and adoption back into it.

This is not a support role bolted onto engineering. You are a full engineer, building with LLM APIs, MCP servers, and the internal AI platform, and you are expected to leave every pattern you build reusable by the next team. What you build feeds the platform layer: the AI Hub, MCP servers, Claude connector delivery, the Skill Hub. As that platform grows into its next layer, LLM access gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, and evaluation frameworks are the current candidates, you will contribute to that build alongside the rest of the Office of AI team, not just consume it.

On the shape of it: this is a small, senior team today, four to five people, and growing on both the engineering and enablement sides. You would be one of two engineers doing this work day to day, with a Staff AI Enablement Engineer setting the technical bar above you.

**Requirements

****What you will do

**

• Prototype, build, and hand over department AI applications, working directly with the business team that will own the outcome

• Run technical enablement sessions with non-engineering teams: walk them through what was built, how to use it, and how to ask for the next thing well

• Guide teams on tech stack choices, MCP servers, AI artefacts (Skills, Connectors, plugins), and integration patterns for AI in a business context

• Ensure every implementation you ship meets GRC standards before it reaches a business user

• Document reusable patterns and components and contribute them back into the platform layer: the AI Hub, MCP servers, Claude connector delivery, the Skill Hub

• Contribute to the platform's next layer as it gets built: LLM access gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, and evaluation frameworks

• Partner with the AI Enablement Lead on the use-case pipeline: help qualify requests, scope builds realistically, and report back on adoption

**What you bring

**

• 5+ years in software engineering, with a full-stack or solutions engineering background

• Genuinely hands-on with AI. You have built and shipped things with LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI, or similar), not just prototyped them

• Strong communication with non-technical stakeholders. You can run a session with a Legal or Finance team and leave them able to use what you built, not just impressed by it

• Working knowledge of MCP servers, AI agent tooling, or integration patterns for AI in a business context

• Security- and governance-conscious engineering practice. You do not need to be told twice that this ships to a regulated business

**Nice to have

**

• Experience in consulting, solutions architecture, or embedded engineering

• Familiarity with the internal stack: Azure or GCP, and Usercentrics' own product platforms

• Exposure to model serving, RAG pipelines, or MLOps

• Background in AI governance or responsible AI deployment

**

jobs.occupation: Head of People Insights, HR Technology & Rewards
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by connecting people, data, technology and business? Can you turn complex workforce topics into clear insights and recommendations for senior leaders? And do you combine strategic perspective with the structure and drive required to make things happen in practice?

**Here Is What The Job Entails

**As our new Head of People Insights, HR Technology & Rewards, you will lead and develop three closely connected areas: maturing People Insights, driving the HR Technology agenda, including Oracle HCM and the global technology roadmap, and providing governance and executive decision support within Rewards in close collaboration with our Rewards Partner.

Leading a small specialist team, you will combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution, personally driving key initiatives, analyses and decision support while working with senior leaders across the business to turn data, technology and governance into clear recommendations and business impact.

More specifically, you will be:

• Building and maturing our People Insights capability through workforce KPIs, executive dashboards and forward-looking insights that support better workforce and organisational decision-making.

• Owning the HR technology landscape and roadmap, acting as senior P&C business owner for Oracle HCM and ensuring systems, data and global processes deliver business value and a strong user experience.

• Leading governance of the global rewards agenda, ensuring effective annual processes, clear decision support and strong collaboration across the business.

• Establishing robust people data and portfolio governance, ensuring clear ownership, data quality, privacy, compliance and effective prioritisation of initiatives, risks and resources.

• Combining strategic leadership with hands-on execution in a small team, setting direction while driving delivery and results.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a broad and evolving agenda, where you can help strengthen the way data, technology and rewards support both leaders and business decisions across Kamstrup.

**Meet your future team

**Reporting directly to the CHRO and being part of the P&C Leadership Team, you will lead a newly established team of three specialists responsible for Global Rewards, Reporting & Master Data and People Systems.

The team plays a crucial role in delivering trusted people data, supporting global reward processes, driving HR systems development and enabling workforce insights across the organization. Together, you will create a stronger governance foundation while continuously improving how People & Culture supports leaders and business performance.

**Less About Us, More About You

**You may come from People Insights, HR Technology, Workforce Strategy, Rewards or HR Transformation. More important than deep expertise across all areas is your ability to lead across disciplines, create structure and turn data, technology and rewards into better business decisions. You likely bring strong experience in People Insights or HR Technology, alongside sufficient rewards and governance expertise to lead the agenda credibly with support from specialists.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Bring experience from a global organisation, ideally within People Insights, HR Technology, Workforce Strategy or HR Transformation.

• Have strong analytical capabilities, including workforce metrics, data visualisation and translating insights into business recommendations.

• Have experience with enterprise HR platforms and transformations, preferably Oracle HCM or a similar cloud-based HCM solution.

• Understand rewards governance, compensation cycles and executive decision processes, enabling effective leadership of the agenda alongside specialists.

• Communicate confidently with senior leaders and provide clear decision support in English.

Success in the role will be reflected in stronger people insights, successful Oracle adoption, improved data quality and rewards processes, and a clear HR technology roadmap, with People & Culture recognised as a trusted, data-driven partner in strategic workforce decision-making.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

**We are more than an ordinary workplace

**We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, on our cycling team, during our yearly summer festival, or on the padel court. For example, our Team lead, Service Delivery is also our volunteer padel instructor while one of our Software Test Engineers run weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

• Beneficial health care and insurance package

**Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

**Please submit your application by using the link below. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and you can expect a response within six weeks.

The job will be located at Kamstrup's headquarters in Stilling, between Aarhus and Skanderborg.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Senior Vice President - Chief People & Culture Officer, Sofie Mørch Ravn, on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

**_Get to know us

_**_At Kamstrup, you'll become part of a close-knit community that genuinely cares about one another, fostering connections both in and out of the workplace. Our team comprises innovators, dreamers, and doers, united by an unyielding passion to challenge the status quo, find better solutions, and constantly push the boundaries of what's possible by being driving by our purpose: We Make What You Measure Matter. With an unwavering commitment to growth, we offer opportunities for you to leverage your skills and drive our business to new heights, empowering you to leave your mark on our future and grow with us.

Do you want to lead project excellence across some of the largest and most complex infrastructure projects in Denmark? Are you an experienced project leader with a commercial mindset? Can you inspire and develop experienced project managers while improving project and portfolio performance? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

To further strengthen our project leadership and support the development of Transportation in Denmark, we are looking for a Vice President, Head of Projects. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of approximately 15 experienced multidisciplinary project managers, while taking direct responsibility for selected strategic projects. You will also have portfolio responsibility for medium-sized and smaller projects led by project managers across the organisation. You will report to the Senior Vice President, Transportation, in Denmark.

You will play a central role in connecting project delivery, portfolio performance, and strategic priorities. The portfolio comprises approximately 350 projects, from large multidisciplinary projects to smaller single-discipline assignments across key transportation disciplines. As a member of the Transportation leadership team, you will contribute to the strategic and operational development of the business.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• Lead and develop a team of multidisciplinary project managers, ensuring clear priorities and high-quality delivery across the portfolio.

• Act as project manager on selected strategic projects, with responsibility for scope, schedule, risk, commercial performance, and client satisfaction.

• Oversee and develop a portfolio of approximately 350 projects, ensuring governance, resource allocation, risk management, financial control, and profitable delivery.

• Improve commercial performance by identifying risks and opportunities early, leading contract and client negotiations, and balancing quality, customer value, and profitability.

• Advance project management excellence across Transportation by developing ways of working and promoting collaboration and knowledge sharing across projects and disciplines.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is your ability to combine strong project management expertise with commercial understanding, stakeholder engagement, and people leadership. You thrive in complex environments where collaboration, cross-team coordination, and professional credibility are essential. You are committed to developing project managers, strengthening project delivery, and creating long-term value for our customers.

On top of that, you will have:

• A degree in civil engineering or other relevant education.

• Extensive project management experience from large multidisciplinary infrastructure projects in Denmark.

• A commercial mindset and solid understanding of portfolio performance, contracts, negotiations, risk, client relations, and financial results.

• Experience developing project management competences and ways of working across teams or portfolios.

• Fluent written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Work location

The position is based in Lyngby or Aarhus, Denmark, with regular travel across our offices.

Want to know more?

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

**The Impact You'll Make

**As our new Pricing Manager, you will develop and execute data-driven pricing strategies across our Flat-Station and Underfloor Heating portfolios, helping maximize gross margin while strengthening our competitive position in the market.

You will make a difference by balancing daily pricing operations with pricing strategy and tool optimization in a project-driven growth business, always taking a customer-focused and holistic view of the business.

Through your work, you'll help drive sustainable market share growth across global customer segments and regional markets while ensuring pricing decisions create value for customers and support profitable growth.

As part of the Portfolio Management team, you'll contribute to driving sustainable commercial success and product excellence across our climate and heating solutions portfolio. Together, we enable customers to improve energy performance, reduce carbon emissions, and create lasting value through innovative and efficient heating applications. You'll join a collaborative, data-driven, and commercially focused team that values open dialogue, continuous learning, constructive feedback, and pragmatic problem-solving.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**In this role, you'll combine strategic pricing leadership with hands-on commercial support to strengthen profitability, improve pricing governance, and enable data-driven decision-making across the business.

**You Will

**

• Lead global and regional pricing strategies, including value-based pricing, discount structures, rebate frameworks, and annual list-price reviews

• Partner with Sales, Portfolio Management, Finance, and Commercial Operations to evaluate tenders, pricing opportunities, and commercial terms

• Analyze transaction data, market trends, competitor activity, input costs, and currency movements to recommend pricing actions that protect and grow margins

• Drive continuous improvement of pricing processes, governance, and digital tools such as Vendavo and SAP to increase efficiency and transparency

• Develop and maintain pricing models, dashboards, KPI scorecards, and reporting that support commercial decision-making

• Success in this role means delivering measurable gross margin expansion, improving price realization, strengthening pricing compliance, and reducing margin leakage across the Flat-Station and Underfloor Heating portfolios

**What We're Looking For

**We're looking for someone who combines commercial acumen, analytical strength, and the ability to influence stakeholders across a global organization.

**Essential Qualifications

**

• Proven track record in strategic pricing, commercial finance, revenue management, or similar commercial roles within a B2B industrial or manufacturing environment

• Demonstrated success leading pricing initiatives that improved profitability, price realization, or overall commercial performance

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and present insights to senior leaders

• Advanced analytical capabilities and proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Business Intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau

• Experience working with pricing, ERP, or commercial systems to support pricing governance and business decision-making

**Preferred Qualifications

**

• Experience working with pricing platforms such as Vendavo and ERP systems such as SAP

• Experience operating within a global or matrix organization

• Knowledge of heating, climate, building solutions, or related industrial markets

**What You'll Get From Us

**In this role, you'll have the opportunity to influence commercial strategy across global markets while supporting innovative heating solutions that improve energy efficiency and help reduce carbon emissions. You'll work closely with experienced colleagues across Sales, Portfolio Management, Finance, and Commercial Operations, gaining broad business exposure and the opportunity to shape how pricing creates value for both customers and Danfoss.

You'll be supported by knowledgeable and experienced colleagues who will help you build a strong understanding of the role, our business, and our customers, ensuring you have the foundation to succeed and grow.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

For information about the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Gerd Veierskov, +45 3057 1882

Associate Professor of the History and Philosophy of Mathematics (Parttime, Fixed-Term, 3½ years)
 Department of Mathematical Sciences
 Faculty of Science
 University of Copenhagen

  The position is in the history and philosophy of mathematics, with particular emphasis on teaching the history of mathematics within the university’s mathematics programs. The position is primarily associated with teaching, developing, and coordinating courses in the history of mathematics at the undergraduate and graduate levels.

  Applicants must have documented research qualifications within the history of mathematics. Emphasis will be placed on scholarly contributions that combine historical scholarship with a strong understanding of mathematics and its development.

  Applicants are required to have university-level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies, and the ability to explain and reflect on their own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training program for assistant professors is required.

  Particular emphasis will be placed on extensive experience teaching the history of mathematics at the university level, including integrating historical perspectives into core mathematics curricula. Experience in developing and coordinating courses in the history of mathematics for students with a mathematical background will be considered an essential qualification.

  Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management, such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare, and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

  Assessment of applicants will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and outreach qualifications of applicants, including the ability to attract external funding, will also be considered.

  To be qualified for an Associate Professor position, you will be assessed according to these five overall criteria for recognising merit at the University of Copenhagen: Research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organisational contribution and leadership. Find information about each criterion.

  The successful applicant will be part of the Analysis and Quantum Section within the Department of Mathematical Sciences. The department offers an active academic environment and access to its academic networks, facilities, seminars, and teaching community. Further information on the Department is linked at http://www.science.ku.dk/english/about-the-faculty/organisation/. Inquiries about the position can be made to the Head of Department, Mogens Steffensen, at head-of-department@math.ku.dk.

  The position is limited until 31 August 2030.

  The average weekly working hours are approximately 11 hours per week.

You are comfortable in an expert role and confident managing stakeholders at every level. We are open to candidates at different career stages, so the depth of experience we look for will vary with your background:

• An M.Sc. in Business, Medicine or Life/Pharmaceutical Sciences.

• Relevant experience in similar roles.

• Experience within the pharmaceutical industry is highly preferred.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable intelligence.

• The ability – or a proven track record – to communicate scientific, medical and commercial information clearly to diverse audiences, including senior management.

• An understanding of drug development, commercial strategy and pharmaceutical value chains, with depth matching your seniority.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience in social media monitoring.

**What You’ll Do

**You will provide high-quality monitoring and insight generation on the commercial competitive landscape and competitor strategies, helping commercial teams act on what is happening in the market today.

• Deliver high-quality, data-driven insights on the commercial competitive landscape across diabetes, obesity, Liver and Cardiovascular disease.

• Drive strong commercial competitive insights that improve decision-making at project, product and portfolio level.

• Lead assessments of key intelligence topics of strategic interest, working with cross-functional stakeholders.

• Act as a strategic partner to Commercial teams, making sure real-time insights are translated into competitive counter-strategies.

• Contribute to building and developing the Commercial Competitive Intelligence function.

• Encourage collaboration and knowledge sharing across the organisation.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Commercial Competitive Intelligence team, which monitors, assesses and activates commercial competitive intelligence within core strategic areas in diabetes, obesity, Liver and CVD. The team is part of Strategic Insights, where you will work alongside colleagues in Customer & Consumer Insights and in Data, Analytics & AI Strategy.

Strategic Insights sits within Product & Portfolio Strategy, which drives commercial strategy, medical affairs and business development across all therapy areas. The area acts as a connector and compass – guiding the portfolio for sustained competitiveness upstream and maximising its potential through strong commercial strategies and competitive launches downstream.

Your closest partners will be Commercial teams, and you will engage with stakeholders across the value chain. Bringing these perspectives together – and creating clarity on what competitor moves mean for Novo – is how your insights will turn into action.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will take on an expert role with real influence: your insights will feed directly into decisions on projects, products and the wider portfolio. You will be trusted to set the agenda, make your voice heard and challenge established thinking when the evidence calls for it.

You will also help develop the Commercial Competitive Intelligence function itself, giving you the chance to shape how the work is done, not just deliver it. Working across commercial, medical and data-focused colleagues, you will broaden your perspective and build new skills on the job. Because we are open to different career stages, your responsibilities and salary will be tailored to your experience.

At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,000.00 to 1,245,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn competitive intelligence into decisions that keep Novo ahead in diabetes and obesity, apply for the Global Assoc Competitive Intelligence Director role by 29 October 2026.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Analog IC Design Lead – Power Management
jobs.description:
Analog IC Design Lead – Power Management

Lotus Microsystems is looking for a motivated and experienced Analog IC Design Lead – Power Management to join our team at our headquarters in Copenhagen. Join a DeepTech company at the forefront of innovation, where ideas move quickly from concept to reality in a collaborative startup environment.

Position Summary

We are looking for an experienced Analog IC Design Lead – Power Management to join our Engineering team. You will lead and contribute to the development of next-generation power converters for a wide range of applications.

You will work on state-of-the-art power management technology alongside a team with hands-on expertise in power electronics, IC design, and semiconductor process development. The role combines technical leadership with hands-on circuit design and close collaboration across disciplines.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide technical leadership for IC development projects and design activities.

• Design integrated power converters and monitoring circuits.

• Design analog and mixed-signal circuit blocks.

• Drive and coordinate IC design and layout activities, working closely with design and layout engineers.

• Simulate and verify circuits using transistor-level and system-level simulation tools.

• Contribute to silicon validation, characterization, and troubleshooting.

• Collaborate with engineers across IC design, power electronics, semiconductor processes, and system development.

Qualifications

• Master’s degree (or higher) in Electrical Engineering or a related field.

• At least 10 years of relevant IC design experience.

• Strong understanding of and hands-on experience with power converters, such as linear regulators, switched-inductor DC-DC converters, and switched-capacitor DC-DC converters.

• In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience in designing integrated power converters, gate drivers, and PWM control circuits.

• In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience in designing analog circuits, including comparators, amplifiers, current sensors, temperature sensors, bandgap references, and related building blocks.

• Experience with IC design environments and EDA tools, such as Cadence (preferred), Synopsys, and/or Mentor Graphics.

• Experience with technical leadership, project leadership, and/or technology leadership in previous IC development projects is a plus.

• Experience with power management ICs (PMICs) and DC-DC converter applications is a plus.

• Experience with PCB design, assembly, and experimental/silicon validation is a plus.

Personal Competencies

• Based in Copenhagen or within reasonable commuting distance. Lotus Microsystems will support relocation for the right candidate, where needed.

• Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary and international team.

• A creative, curious, and innovative mindset, with a passion for solving complex technical challenges.

• Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain and champion new ideas, actively contribute to brainstorming, and present technical concepts clearly.

• Strong planning and time-management skills, with the ability to adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced startup environment.

Additional Information

For more information about the position, please contact Martin Lantz, IC Design Manager, at mlantz@lotus-microsystems.com.

We will process candidates on a running basis.

About Us

Lotus Microsystems creates advanced power solutions that transform power and thermal management, unlocking the full potential of AI and advanced computing. Our patented power silicon interposer technology enables miniaturized power delivery systems with exceptional power density and thermal performance.

At Lotus Microsystems in Copenhagen, you will experience an informal, collaborative, and hands-on work environment. Our open office setup fosters strong teamwork and close interaction among colleagues.

Although we are a small team, we are truly international, with colleagues from diverse professional and cultural backgrounds. This diversity enriches our work and gives us a global perspective that resonates with our international customers and partners.

Join Lotus Microsystems and help us develop cutting-edge power technology that can make a meaningful impact on the future of AI and advanced computing.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.occupation: Solution Architect, EndoIntelligence Hardware, Global R&D
jobs.description:
Do you want to help bring innovative medical solutions to life and improve patient care worldwide?

**Do you have a strong technical background within hardware development and experience designing solutions for complex products involving multiple technologies? Then this could be an exciting opportunity for you. Apply today and join us for a career #ForeverForward!

**Designing solutions for next-generation endoscopy systems

**At Ambu, we develop innovative endoscopy solutions used by healthcare professionals around the world. As part of the EndoIntelligence Solutions area in the Global R&D organization, you will work closely with colleagues across engineering, product management, operations, quality, and regulatory affairs to develop solutions that meet customer needs and business objectives.

As Hardware Solution Architect you will play a key role in defining and maturing hardware solutions for our endoscopy platforms. Working closely with systems engineers, project teams, engineering specialists, suppliers, and technology partners, you will help ensure solutions are technically robust, scalable, and aligned with overall system requirements.

Our teams work in a collaborative environment where open dialogue, technical curiosity, and cross-functional teamwork are key to solving complex challenges.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your main responsibilities will include:

• Participate in early-phase product development activities, including concept development, technology evaluations, and feasibility assessments.

• Guide the development and maturation of hardware solutions in collaboration with cross-functional development teams.

• Define and maintain solution architectures for new products and platform developments.

• Collaborate across mechanical, electronics, optics, manufacturing, and software disciplines to develop integrated system solutions.

• Support architectural trade-off discussions balancing performance, reliability, manufacturability, risk, and cost.

• Ensure solutions are aligned with system requirements, architectural principles, and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Collaborate with suppliers and technology partners on technical evaluations, component selection, and solution development.

• Contribute technical input to project planning and development activities.

• Maintain solution documentation and support architectural reviews.

• Support development and verification activities by helping resolve technical challenges and identifying potential risks.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experience can be gained in many different ways, and we recognize that no candidate will match every qualification perfectly. You are, however, likely to succeed in this role if you:

• Hold a degree in Electronics, Mechatronics, Engineering, Physics, Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, or a related technical field.

• Have experience developing complex products involving multiple technologies and engineering disciplines.

• Have experience with technical solution design, system architecture, or product development.

• Have experience with medical devices or other regulated industries.

• Enjoy working across disciplines to solve technical challenges and drive alignment.

• Have experience collaborating with external suppliers, development partners, or technology providers.

• Possess strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Thrive in a collaborative and international environment.

English language proficiency, both written and spoken, is crucial for the role.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success, and by joining us you will become part of an international organization focused on developing innovative solutions that improve patient care worldwide.

We offer great opportunities for professional and personal development, a broad range of employee benefits, exciting technical challenges, and continuous learning throughout your career.

Celare Quantum Communications is a Danish high-tech quantum technology company with a mission to radically improve cybersecurity and enable trusted global data sharing.

Our core product is a unique, cutting-edge technology born from years of university research called Continuous-Variable Quantum Key Distribution (CV-QKD). This technology enables post-quantum secure key exchange for protecting sensitive data across critical infrastructure.

Celare partners with local and international governments, telecom operators, data centers, banks, defense ministries, and leading academic institutions. Over the past year our team has successfully launched commercial pilot deployments of our technology.

The Celare Team

We are a highly specialized and ambitious team of quantum engineers, serial entrepreneurs, laser, RF and electronics specialists, mathematicians, software engineers, and IC and FPGA designers.

Based in Copenhagen, we combine deep academic expertise with hands-on experience in launching complex, high-impact technology products.

The Role

In this role you will get a unique opportunity to work at the cutting edge of quantum technology development. You will be part of a small team of optical engineers responsible for optical development and test activities in the company. You will have a key role in our Photonic Integrated Circuit (PIC) development activities as a technical point of contact with our development partners.

As part of a small and agile organization, you will contribute across the full product lifecycle — from early architectural decisions and prototyping to production and large-scale deployment. You will work both in collaboration with our team and independently as a specialist, sharing knowledge across disciplines.

This is a hands-on role with real responsibility and influence. It offers work with an international, multilingual and multicultural dynamic team with direct connection to academic research and bleeding-edge technologies.

The role is situated on site in our Copenhagen headquarters.

Responsibilities

• Leading and carrying out various PIC development activities

• Planning and execution of PIC test activities

• Development of optical subsystems for our CV-QKD and Quantum Random Number Generator (QRNG) products

• Maintaining and extending the company’s optical laboratories

• Contributing specialist knowledge and collaborating to make the team excel at product development

Qualifications

• MSc or PhD in optics or similar

• 5+ years of work experience

• Experience with conducting experiments in fiber and/or free-space optics

• Experience with PIC technology and development

• Hands-on experience working with digital/analog electronics

• (Optional) Experience in using quantum theory

We Offer

This full-time position offers the opportunity to build and shape the future of quantum communication in collaboration with an experienced and dynamic team. We provide individual growth plans aligned with your personal preferences and motivation. We offer competitive compensation, depending on qualifications.

Contact

For more information or if you wish to apply, send an email to jobs@celare-quantum.com and mark the subject line: “Optical Engineer”.
